summary: First-build E2E validation of BedForge QC. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (auth, dashboard, tension, beams, anomalies, inspections, forms export). Frontend: All 10 review-listed flows pass via Playwright — login (valid+invalid), token stored as bf_token, 6 stat cards + 8 bed cards, bed-card->twin nav, 3D canvas + pick-required anomaly toast, tension calc (theoretical 34.103 in for defaults; WITHIN at 34.5, OUT at 40), QIR guided flow save, xlsx export of all 4 forms with valid PK-header content, logout clears token, protected route redirect.

minor.issue: InspectionCreate model accepts field name 'status' (not 'gate' as review_request implied) with values pass/fail/hold. Frontend uses correct field. Just a naming inconsistency between review_request and code.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard. Not blocking since app uses Bearer tokens in header, but should be explicit origins for cookie fallback path.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text in a <span>. Non-blocking (dev warning only) but pollutes console.

action_items: Optional: tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit list instead of '*' when allow_credentials=True.
Optional: cleanup TEST_-prefixed anomaly/inspection rows created by backend_test.py if regression-run frequently.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_current_user checks httpOnly cookie fallback but login endpoint never sets it — cookie branch is dead code today. Fine since frontend uses Bearer header.
server.py update_bed sets updated_at by constructing a throwaway Bed() to grab default now_iso — brittle; use now_iso() directly.
server.py CORS middleware added AFTER app.include_router — works in FastAPI but conventional order is before route inclusion.
seed_admin idempotently updates admin password if env changes (good). Demo users are only created if missing — password rotation for demo accounts would require manual reset.

Inspection payload uses field 'status' (not 'gate'); values are pass/fail/hold. Tension defaults produce theoretical ≈ 34.103 in (spec says ~34.1). All export endpoints return valid xlsx (PK header).
